title: 5 Hidden Features Inside Claude Cowork
description:
Most people use Claude Cowork like a basic chatbot. Which means they miss the features that change what it can do. 

The five hidden ones worth knowing are Projects for persistent memory, Connectors that plug Claude into your apps, Computer Use that lets Claude run apps for you, Skills that act as custom slash commands, and Plugins for community-built tools. 

Most users don't even know these exist.
